The preceptor then spoke these words: “I did not know them as the heroic scions of the family of Yadu and Vṛṣṇi.” Thereupon Kṛṣṇa who had done his duty, spoke these words to Sāndīpani in a delighted mood: Along with Balarāma, he asked, “What shall I give as the fee unto the preceptor?” On hearing those hearty words, the delighted preceptor said: “Through your effort I wish to get back my son who died in the salty sea.
